label: Activity Tracker
info:
Shows the watch's activity. mqtt_receiver.py (on the same Pi) publishes everything the dashboard needs on the MQTT topic activity/summary; this flow only displays it.
Dashboard: http://<pi-address>:1880/dashboard

name: activity/summary  ->  4 sections (Overview + System health)
info:
The function nodes turn the summary into HTML; each ui-template shows one section.
Edit the source in server/nodered/src and rebuild with build_flow.py.
